title: T8.2b: Decided changes in runtime shell, widgets, telemetry and examples
description:
Owner-approved changes: wire widget transitions with an injected clock, trim the runtime shell (dead chrome render path, badges module, audit/mute stubs), reduce the change-efficiency artifact to counters, delete the soak suite, rewrite vertical_slice onto T5 verbs. Includes the freeze escalation.

Line refs are at windows-release-pipeline@44d355ef (same content as main@1eb8f7cb); re-grep symbols before editing. The planning survey is not persisted; this bead is self-contained.
design:

[decision] Change-efficiency artifact -> counters; keep one idle-no-redraw behavior test.
[decision] Delete the soak suite.
[decision] Keep vertical_slice (required check) and the weekly perf lane.

dependencies.title: T8: Code and test diet
dependencies.description:
Shrink tze_hud to match the reset (docs/scope.md T8 row): delete code with no current user, replace oversized and structural test files with behavior tests tied to docs/invariants.md, add tze_hud_resource behavior tests, add a local llvmpipe recipe for compositor GPU tests, cut CI/justfile waste, and strip pre-reset references (openspec, RFCs, doctrine, bead-id breadcrumbs). Baseline ~304k lines, ~60% test code; target about -80k.

Work is grouped into eight milestone sub-epics (enablers; dead code x2; decided deletions x2; test diets x2; tooling and lock-in). Owner decisions for plan questions are inlined in each bead as [decision] lines; two hard-gated items are needs-human escalation beads.

Overlaps owned elsewhere (T8 does not duplicate them): safe-mode entry/overlay hud-jm8nq.1/.10; disconnection badge hud-jm8nq.12; idle no-redraw hud-jm8nq.8; widget raster counter hud-jm8nq.13; examples/dashboard_tile_agent deletion hud-jm8nq.15; tile POC acceptance tests hud-jm8nq.14; gpu_lock -> single-instance mutex hud-i2e10.6; SSH skill tooling hud-i2e10.12; the portal/projection stack is T7 (hud-lirh2).

Line refs are at windows-release-pipeline@44d355ef (same content as main@1eb8f7cb); re-grep symbols before editing. The planning survey is not persisted; this bead is self-contained.
dependencies.design:
Sub-epics are milestone groupings so each stays within 3-7 children. Lanes: run each sub-epic as one lane (shared crate context). P1 enablers first; the two test-file splits (renderer/tests.rs, session_server/tests.rs) land before T7/POC edit those files. Owner answers: decisions.md '## T8' (2026-10-03) is inlined per bead.
[decision] gpu_lock is T6's (hud-i2e10.6); T8 does not touch it.
[decision] Delete CHANGELOG.md and bead-ID breadcrumbs in comments.
[decision] Keep drag / movable elements.
